startup_rows.failed_witness: The first complete activation-candidate render exceeded the attributable display boundary before EOF.
startup_rows.passing_bounded_witness: The complete 16,189-word committed candidate was read through EOF without repository mutation.
startup_rows.recovery: Measure the committed Git blob and read five bounded literal character windows through the exact end.
startup_rows.recurrence_guard: Measure large packets before rendering and use bounded windows from the first read.

startup_rows.failed_witness: The first activation metadata line-count probe returned one because its PowerShell newline split was incorrect.
startup_rows.passing_bounded_witness: The exact blob measured 126,493 bytes and 16,189 words with SHA-256 0dd0eb0ba25baebcecdf6ae57fb4a45f0aac9c97b93bd667c555db868a7a2fb8.
startup_rows.recovery: Use exact Git-blob bytes, character length, word count, terminal characters, and SHA-256 instead of the faulty line projection.
startup_rows.recurrence_guard: Do not use an unverified platform-specific newline split as an EOF proof.

startup_rows.failed_witness: A skill-metadata PowerShell projection produced an empty-pipe parser error.
startup_rows.passing_bounded_witness: The corrected bounded projection returned the selected skill metadata without mutation.
startup_rows.recovery: Materialize the projection into a scalar array before piping it to the serializer.
startup_rows.recurrence_guard: Assign foreach output before a trailing PowerShell pipeline.

startup_rows.failed_witness: An overbroad skill-directory listing exceeded the useful display boundary.
startup_rows.passing_bounded_witness: All selected lifecycle, Method Flow, manifest, privacy, canonical, source, roster, and route instructions were read through EOF.
startup_rows.recovery: Select only the directly applicable family-current skills and read each complete SKILL.md and required reference.
startup_rows.recurrence_guard: Use exact skill routing rather than broad directory rendering.

startup_rows.failed_witness: A combined current-guidance and reference display was truncated before every required file reached EOF.
startup_rows.passing_bounded_witness: Every selected guidance and schema reached EOF and the live activation was applied as the newest exact authority.
startup_rows.recovery: Read the Method Flow schema, current roster, routing precedence, overlay, and authorization state separately in bounded windows.
startup_rows.recurrence_guard: Keep large mutable state separate from companion schema reads.

startup_rows.failed_witness: A combined inherited-manifest render was truncated before all four manifest bodies were attributable.
startup_rows.passing_bounded_witness: Seventeen x1, 140 evidence, 23 final-delta, and 173 final-owner entries replayed with zero mismatches.
startup_rows.recovery: Replay all entries through one bounded Git cat-file batch and report only manifest counts and mismatches.
startup_rows.recurrence_guard: For large manifests, validate blobs in batch and render compact attributable totals.

startup_rows.failed_witness: A template file-length probe placed a pipeline directly after foreach and produced an empty-pipe parser error.
startup_rows.passing_bounded_witness: The corrected exact-path probe returned byte and line counts for every existing template file.
startup_rows.recovery: Materialize the file metadata rows before serializing them.
startup_rows.recurrence_guard: Use a named collection for PowerShell foreach output before piping.

startup_rows.failed_witness: A template inspection guessed two nonexistent tool filenames and returned two missing-path diagnostics.
startup_rows.passing_bounded_witness: The exact constraint-board, custody-tribunal, and evidence-guard source filenames were resolved without mutation.
startup_rows.recovery: Discover the exact source-owned v670-v2 filenames with a bounded rg --files filter, then read only those paths.
startup_rows.recurrence_guard: Enumerate exact owner filenames before borrowing descriptive names from a design note.

startup_rows.failed_witness: The first x1 build failed closed before artifact writes because proposal AL6703-N040 exactly duplicated Ilyra proposal IF6702-N040 and crossed the semantic-neighbor threshold.
startup_rows.passing_bounded_witness: The unchanged semantic-neighbor algorithm accepted all forty Auren titles below the 0.72 threshold on the corrected build.
startup_rows.recovery: Inspect only the colliding pair and rewrite the Auren gate around phase-specific nonadmission prerequisites while preserving its exact-gate disposition.
startup_rows.recurrence_guard: Run the source-owner neighbor audit before freezing any inherited terminal-gate phrasing.

x2_operational_rows.passing_bounded_witness: The unchanged five-file Ruff scope passed after only import ordering was normalized.

x2_operational_rows.passing_bounded_witness: The split recovery produced attributable manifest coverage and privacy-disposition results without changing the audited blobs.
x2_operational_rows.recovery: Confirm process quiescence, retain the unattributable attempt, and split the unchanged scope into one exact manifest replay and one single-read staged privacy scan.
x2_operational_rows.recurrence_guard: Preserve long-running session identifiers or split Git-blob loops before their initial yield budget.
